create_training_agent: create a training agent with dqn, bdqn, qlearning, a2c, impala, or regret matching algorithm
run_poprl_training: run population-based reinforcement learning training loop for repeated rock-paper-scissors game
eval_agent: evaluate a learning agent against a population of roshambo bots and collect prediction accuracy
build_rolling_average: build a rolling average tracker to monitor training metrics over a configurable window size
test_checkpoint: test saving and restoring agent checkpoints with numpy random state and rolling averages
